name: dsh-llm-agy
description: Antigravity CLI (AGY) integration for dsh: an `agy` model provider (Gemini 3.8/3.7/3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude 4.6, GPT-OSS 120B) in the model picker, subagent delegation via subagent_agy_ui, image reading for text-only models via read_image_agy, AGY-powered Google search, account quota/usage monitoring, and a settings card with install/login status, live connectivity test and proxy configuration. Non-blocking model catalog and standard system-proxy resolution. Hot-pluggable - no dsh source changes.
//runtime-peer-deps: 本插件的服务端入口会 import 宿主 dsh 的包(见 scripts/link-runtime-deps.mjs 的 RUNTIME_PACKAGES)。这些包不写进 dependencies/peerDependencies:一旦声明,pnpm 会尝试从 registry 拉取整套 @deepseek-ai/*(其中含未发布包,必然 404),安装直接中断。运行期解析由 node scripts/link-runtime-deps.mjs 链接本机 dsh 安装提供,离线且版本与宿主一致。
